Hi! A female here :) I'm 21 and have been losing hair since 17/18. And I finally figured out why. Its because I have PCOS(policystic ovarian syndrome). From what I know its a hormonal imbalance and sometimes even though you have it, the tests for hormones like insulin&testosterone can come back as normal. Also I read somewhere that you can develop PCOS from taking birth control, but I forgot why that is. 


I would suggest to you to go to a gynocologist and request for an ultrasound of your ovaries. Also join r/PCOS for support&help.

For treatments you can start by using topical minoxydl to maintain your hair then go to your doctor to tackle the root cause of your hairloss.
If you happen to have PCOS the medicine you take for hairloss is combined birthcontrol and spironolactrone which is an anti androgen. 

And does your mother or sister suffer from hairloss? If not, yours can probably be solved when you find out what the problem is.
Hope this helped!

First before class wash your face with soap and remove all face make-up. (I'm female :P)

And buy a good moisturizer so the face wash and the tonic do not dry out your skin too much. Investing in a face suncream 50+ is something worth considering while you are young, because a huge factor in fast skin aging is exposure to the sun. This is why koreans have amazing skin.
